findings.title: Codex adapter specifies undocumented CLI flags
findings.body: The design requires invoking Codex with `--ignore-user-config` and `--ignore-rules`, but these are not documented Codex CLI options. The published Codex CLI reference documents configuration through `CODEX_HOME`/configuration files and project-document controls, but does not define either flag: https://developers.openai.com/codex/cli/reference/. Implementing this literally would cause Codex startup to fail with an unknown-option error rather than isolate the invocation. Use only documented Codex isolation mechanisms and verify the exact installed-version command contract.

suggested_fix.description: Remove the undocumented flags and specify a supported isolation approach, such as temporary CODEX_HOME/HOME roots and documented configuration options, verified against the pinned Codex version.
